imports.modification_summary: Keeps the declarative-form tool recognition and the form-control-to-schema rules (input types, number and step bounds, temporal formats, option, radio and checkbox choices, labels, fieldset descriptions, duplicate-name handling). Works on an attribute-only DOM model from a CDP DOMSnapshot instead of the live DOM, in one linear tree pass under a CPU budget; models shadow roots as separate tree scopes, labels as labelling only their first labelable descendant, and the first-legend exemption of disabled fieldsets; matches attribute names exactly. Removes tool registration, listeners, submission, respondWith and every page mutation. Never emits a control value; skips editable regions in label text; omits password-like controls (also via autocomplete) and flags the tool. Number schemas carry no pattern and drop contradictory bounds. Every string and collection is bounded; text is made well formed (lone surrogates become U+FFFD) and free of controls and bidi marks, and exact values (names, choices, patterns) with such characters are refused. Names shaped like host identities are not tools.
imports.authority_delta: Read-only page data only; no execution, input, navigation or exposure authority.
qualification: native discovery test with page-script traps and an armed trap control

not_imported.reason: The schema subset is produced directly by the adapted form rules and re-checked by the Rust host validator; no generic JSON Schema handling is needed for read-only discovery.
A second channel to the browser (rejected in WEB_CAPABILITIES_DECISION.md).
